High Courts Address Lawyers' Strikes, Election Duty, Student Exams

The Punjab and Haryana High Court expressed hope for an amicable resolution to a lawyers' strike against the LADC scheme. Separately, the Delhi High Court questioned the Election Commission's authority regarding the deployment of teachers for election-related duties. The Supreme Court ruled that law students cannot be barred from exams due to attendance shortages. Meanwhile, the Congress party demanded the withdrawal of cases against student protesters in Mumbai.
